subject: stf
title: STF.-----PROJ.DY
description: First of two diagrams in T(IMP)M-21. The following prose names the structural target: 'My reason for commenting on the historical progressions of improvised music from the black aesthetic is to give some understanding as to how once a form has been adopted by the controlling forces of western culture, the meta-reality potential of that form usually retards.' The crossing diagrams how source-transfer structurally meets projectional-dynamics at the meta-reality-retardation scale: STF (source transfer) crossed with PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). STF sits at lower-left with the subject-arrow; RE-ST (restructuralism) at upper-center and PROJ-DY at upper-right, with MOT-DY and LG-DY (logical dynamics) at the upper-right margin on a branch from PRI-INFO's line. IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) at upper-left branches from the main line and carries RE-ST and RT-DY (reality dynamics); CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) at left hangs from RT-DY's line, and RT-DY sits at lower-left. PRI-INFO (principle information) sits at right-center on a branch from the main line. INFO-INTG (information integration) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) sit lower-right: T-C-IMP branches from PROG-CONT's line and INFO-INTG from T-C-IMP's line. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) at bottom-center, on a vertical from the main line.
